verdicts.reason: The two banners are almost identical. In both, the headline breaks badly onto two lines, leaving 'fizz' as an orphan word. The legal text squeezed under the CTA is a few pixels tall and can't be read. The SOLSTICE can is shrunk to a speck, and the logo, can, headline and CTA sit in a cramped row of separate pieces. B adds decorative circles that crowd in behind the logo and can, so A is marginally cleaner.
